system.description:
Once per encounter, plant yourself and let a single enemy within 10ft feel exactly what they're up against — unless they pass a Will save against your Class Save DC (using Charisma), they fight the rest of the round flinching, at Disadvantage.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

activities.name: Intimidating Presence
activities.text: One enemy within 10ft makes a Will save against your Class Save DC (using Charisma): unless it passes, it fights the rest of the round at Disadvantage.
